preconditions.description: Input integers n and k satisfy 2 <= k < n <= 1000.

preconditions.expression: len(parts) == 2 and all(p.isdigit() for p in parts)
preconditions.description: The input line contains exactly two space-separated integers.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two lines.
The first line contains a positive integer c representing the minimum number of colors.
The second line contains exactly n(n-1)/2 integers representing edge colors.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= c for x in colors)
postconditions.description: Every color in the output is an integer between 1 and c inclusive.
Exactly c distinct colors are used in the construction.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(path_colors)) >= 2 for path_colors in (get_path_colors(colors, n, k, start, end) for start in range(1, n+1) for end in range(start + k, n+1)))
postconditions.description: For every path of length k or greater (from node a to node b where b - a >= k), the set of edge colors along that path contains at least 2 distinct colors.
The value c is the minimum number of colors required to satisfy the rainbow path condition for all paths of length k or longer.
